a. Organic Fertilizers are derived from plant or animal materials. Manure,
compost and seaweed are good examples of organic fertilizers.Similarly,plant
material called mulch e.g. hay, leaves, bark, wood chips, seed hulls and corn
husks arealsoorganicfertilizer.

b. Inorganic or Chemical Fertilizers are primarily derived from chemical
compoundssuchas ammonium nitrate,ammonium phosphate and potassium
chloride. Examples of inorganic fertilizers are sodium nitrate, mined rock
phosphateandlimestone.
8.2.2'Advantagesofinorganicfertillizers
Higher and accurate amount of nitrogen promotes protein and chlorophyll
synthesis and encourages growth of stems andleaves.
Higher amount of phosphorus results in more flowers, larger fruns and
healthierroots.
